title: Lemon Soy Chicken with Rice

steps.text: Mix the juice of the lemon, the soy sauce and the grated ginger. Add the chicken breast and turn to coat.
Cover and marinate in the refrigerator, not on the counter, for 30 minutes.
Rinse the rice and cook it according to the package instructions.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the chicken 6 to 7 minutes per side until the thickest part reads 165°F (74°C) on a meat thermometer. Discard the used marinade.
Rest the chicken for 3 minutes, slice, and serve over the rice.

safety_notes: Chicken must reach 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.
Never reuse raw-chicken marinade as a sauce.
Wash hands, board and knife after handling raw chicken.

title: Garlic Herb Roasted Chicken Thighs

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the chicken thighs dry.
Rub the thighs with olive oil, minced garlic, thyme, salt and pepper. Place skin side up on a tray.
Roast for 35 to 45 minutes, until the thickest part reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Rest 5 minutes, squeeze lemon over the top, and serve.

safety_notes: Chicken must reach at least 165°F (74°C); thighs taste best around 175°F (80°C).
Wash hands and surfaces after touching raw chicken.

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio

steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente, about 9 minutes. Save a cup of pasta water.
Meanwhile, gently warm the olive oil with thinly sliced garlic and chili flakes over low heat until the garlic is pale gold.
Toss the drained pasta in the pan with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Stir in the parsley and serve.

safety_notes: Keep garlic on low heat; it burns quickly and turns bitter.

steps.text: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Warm the olive oil and sliced garlic in a pan for 1 minute, then add the canned tomatoes.
Simmer the sauce for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, and season with salt and pepper.
Toss the drained pasta in the sauce, tear in the basil, and serve.

title: Egg Fried Rice

steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok or large pan over high heat.
Scramble the eggs until fully set, then push them to the side.
Add the cold rice and peas and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until steaming hot all the way through.
Add the soy sauce and green onion, toss, and serve.

safety_notes: Use rice that was cooled within 1 hour of cooking and kept refrigerated; leftover rice left out can grow harmful bacteria.

steps.text: Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Cut the broccoli, carrot and bell pepper into bite-size pieces.
Stir-fry the carrot and broccoli in hot oil for 4 minutes, then add the pepper, garlic and ginger for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, toss for 1 minute, and serve over the rice.

title: Shakshuka

steps.text: Soften the sliced onion and pepper in olive oil over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and paprika for 30 seconds, then add the canned tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook 6 to 8 minutes until the whites are fully set.
Serve straight from the pan.

safety_notes: Cook eggs until the whites and yolks are firm if serving anyone vulnerable (young children, pregnant, elderly).

steps.text: Drain the beans and mash them roughly with the cumin. Dice the onion.
Spread beans, onion and cheese over half of each tortilla and fold.
Toast in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese has melted.
Cut into wedges and serve.

title: Red Lentil Soup

steps.text: Soften the diced onion and carrot in olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add the rinsed lentils and the broth, bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Blend part of the soup for a creamy texture if you like, season, and serve.

safety_notes: Cool leftovers within 2 hours and refrigerate; reheat until steaming hot.

title: Ground Beef Taco Skillet

steps.text: Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Brown the ground beef with the diced onion over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 160°F (71°C).
Stir in cumin, paprika and the canned tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes.
Serve over the rice and top with cheese.

safety_notes: Wash hands and tools after touching raw meat.

title: Lemon Garlic Salmon with Rice

steps.text: Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat with the minced garlic. Cook the salmon 4 minutes per side until it flakes and reads 145°F (63°C).
Squeeze lemon over the salmon and serve with the rice.

safety_notes: Fish should reach 145°F (63°C) and flake easily.
Keep raw fish refrigerated until cooking.

title: Fluffy Pancakes

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Whisk the milk, egg and melted butter, pour into the dry mix, and stir until just combined. Lumps are fine.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes.
Cook 1/4 cup scoops on a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.

safety_notes: Don't taste raw batter; it contains raw egg and flour.

steps.text: Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Soften the diced onion in oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and drained chickpeas. Simmer 15 minutes until thickened.
Season with salt and serve over the rice.
